blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Post-training binds the competence of an LLM agent to the interface it was trained on. Semantics-preserving perturbations of that interface, such as renaming an action or changing the notation, leave the underlying task unchanged yet make the agent worse at it. Scoring each sample independently means interface randomization only broadens this dependence from a single interface to the training interface distribution, so out-of-distribution perturbations still degrade the agent. We propose Cross-Interface Policy Regularization (CIPR), a self-supervised objective that replaces action names with uninformative identifiers and presents each training sample under two interfaces in which equivalent actions are identified by construction. CIPR penalizes the KL divergence between the action distributions induced under the two interfaces, so the policy behaves consistently across them. We evaluate CIPR in both supervised and reinforcement-learning post-training, where it improves robustness. On agentic function calling, held-out interface perturbations reduce the accuracy of a post-trained agent by nearly 25%, and CIPR recovers 10.5% while leaving accuracy on the unchanged interface intact.
blocks.zh: 培训后将LLM代理的能力与其培训的接口挂钩。 语义学-保留对接口的扰动,如重命名动作或改变标记,使基本任务不变,但使代理人更糟糕。 独立分解每个样本意味着接口随机化只能将这种依赖性从一个单一的接口扩大到训练接口分布,因此外分配扰动仍然可以降解代理. 我们提出跨部门政策规范化(CIPR),这是一个自我监督的目标,将行动名称替换为非信息标识符,并在两个接口下介绍每个培训样本,其中通过建筑确定相应的行动。 CIPR惩罚了KL在两个接口下引发的行动分布之间的分歧,因此政策在它们之间表现一致. 我们通过监督和强化后培训,对社区康复中心进行评价,以提高其活力。 在代理函数调用上,悬浮式接口扰动将训练后剂的精度降低近25%,CIPR恢复了10.5%,同时将精度保留在未变的接口上不变.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Language models are now trained to act as tool-using agents, either natively ( Qwen Team, 2026 ; Kimi Team, 2025 ) , or by fine-tuning on agent trajectories and reinforcement learning from task rewards ( Zeng et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2026 ) .
What these agents learn, however, is tied to the interface through which their tools are presented, meaning the names, descriptions, and argument schemas of the available tools.
Figure 1 illustrates this with a weather agent trained on a single interface, which fails when its forecast tool is renamed and when a cheaper equivalent is added, although neither change alters the task.
Agents fine-tuned on trajectories can lose most of their task success when action names are minimally rewritten ( Gu et al., 2026 ) , and function-calling models degrade when tools are renamed, similar tools are added, or requests are rephrased ( Ye et al., 2024 ; Rabinovich and Tavor, 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ) .
Such changes are routine in deployment, where registries combine tools from different servers, providers revise their schemas, and users misspell requests ( Zhou et al., 2026b ) .
Interfaces can also be manipulated, since edits to a tool’s description alone can make agents prefer it over equivalent tools ( Faghih et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
语言模型现在被训练成为工具使用代理,或者在本土(Quen Team, 2026;Kimi Team, 2025),或者在代理轨迹上进行微调并强化学习任务奖励(Zeng等, 2024;Qian等, 2026).
然而,这些代理人学到的东西与展示其工具的界面有关,即现有工具的名称、描述和论证方案。
图1用在单一界面上训练的气象媒介来说明这一点,当其预测工具被重新命名并添加了更便宜的等同物时,气象媒介就失效了,尽管两个改变都不改变任务。
当动作名称被最小重写(Gu等,2026年),且功能调用模型被重新命名后会退化,添加类似的工具,或者被重写请求(Ye等,2024年;Rabinovich和Tavor,2025年;Zhou等,2026年b.)时,对轨迹进行微调的代理人可能会失去大部分任务成功.
这种变化在部署中是例行的,登记册将来自不同服务器的工具、供应商修改其计划以及用户Misspell请求(周等,2026b.)结合起来。
界面也可以被操纵,因为仅编辑一个工具的描述就可以使代理商喜欢它而不是等同的工具(Faghih等,2025年).

在每个栏目中,我们先训练一个代理人来获取天气预报(上),然后在重命名的接口(界面1)上进行推断(下)测试,再在其中测试一个附加的更便宜的预报工具(界面2).

CIPR也比较了跨界面的政策,在两种情况下都通过描述来选择.

blocks.en:
This failure is an instance of shortcut learning ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ) .
On a fixed training interface, a policy that reads the tool descriptions and a policy that relies on a familiar name or a position in the tool list make the same calls and earn the same reward, so the task objective has no reason to prefer the first.
The second policy fails as soon as the interface changes, even if the task is unchanged.
Such a policy can still succeed on new tasks under its training interface, so the failure is one of generalizing across interfaces rather than of fitting noise in the training examples.
blocks.zh:
这一失败是捷径学习的例子(Geirhos等,2020年)。
在固定的训练界面上,一个读取工具描述的政策,以及一个依赖于熟悉的名称或工具列表中的职位的政策,发出相同的呼叫并获得同样的奖励,因此任务目标没有理由偏好第一个.
第二个策略在接口改变后立即失效,即使任务不变.
这种政策在其培训接口下的新任务上仍然能够取得成功,因此失败是跨越接口的通俗化,而不是在培训实例中安装噪音。

blocks.en:
Prior training methods reduce this sensitivity by changing what the agent trains on.
Function masking replaces tool and argument names with random strings ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , which removes one cue but leaves others, such as a tool’s position or the set of tools offered.
Multi-interface training, also known as domain randomization, varies tool schemas, metadata, and question formats during training ( Zhou et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026a ) , and synthetic corpora such as ToolACE broaden the tools seen in training ( Liu et al., 2025 ) .
Both approaches still score each training interface on its own.
Their objective asks the policy to succeed under every interface it sees, but never to treat equivalent interfaces alike, so a policy can fit every training variant while keeping a shortcut that fails on a new kind of change, as in the middle column of Figure 1 .
blocks.zh:
先前的训练方法通过改变特工的训练内容来降低这种敏感性.
函数掩码用随机字符串取代了工具和参数名(Lin等,2025年),它取消了一个提示而留下了其他提示,例如工具的位置或所提供的一组工具.
多界面培训,又称域随机化,在培训期间,工具计划,元数据,和问题格式各不相同(周等,2026b;刘等,2026a),而TolleACE等合成公司拓宽了培训中看到的工具(刘等,2025).
这两种方法仍然各自对每个培训接口进行评分。
他们的目标要求政策在它所看到的每一个界面下都成功,但绝不像对待等同的接口那样,因此一个政策可以适应每一个培训变体,同时保留一条在新变化中失败的捷径,如图一的中栏.

blocks.en:
The interface changes an agent meets in deployment cannot all be anticipated, so robustness should not depend on training on each of them.
Instead, the agent should treat interfaces that offer equivalent tools alike, including interfaces it has never seen.
We propose Cross-Interface Policy Regularization (CIPR), which trains for this property directly (Figure 2 ).
CIPR uses a correspondence that multi-interface training discards, since whenever we construct a perturbed interface, we know which of its tools is equivalent to which tool in the original.
We canonicalize each training interface, replacing every tool name with a neutral identifier such as function_01 , so that names carry no task information.
Canonicalization leaves other cues in place, such as a tool’s position, so we pair the canonical interface with a perturbed copy in which the tools are renamed, reordered, and joined by degraded twins.
We then penalize the KL divergence between the agent’s action distributions under the two interfaces, with the canonical interface as the reference.
Unlike prior consistency regularization, which asks a model for the same output under both inputs ( Xie et al., 2020 ; Zhou et al., 2026a ) , this term lets the response change with the tool names and compares only the distributions over actions, with each tool matched to its counterpart through the known correspondence.
The consistency KL has two terms.
The rescoring consistency KL holds a response fixed and compares the action distributions along it, which needs no additional generation, and the rollout consistency KL lets each interface produce its own responses, since a different interface can call for different reasoning.
We add both terms to the task loss, and they need no labels beyond those of the task.

blocks.en:
We evaluate CIPR in reinforcement-learning and supervised post-training under interface perturbations held out from training.
On function calling with two backbones, CIPR is more robust than the base model and standard post-training, and it improves on multi-interface training in all three groups of held-out perturbations while keeping original accuracy (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh:
我们在强化学习方面对社区康复中心进行评价,并在培训过程中进行的界面干扰下监督培训。
在调用两根主干线的功能上,CIPR比基础模型和标准后培训更加有力,它改进了所有三组被搁置扰动的多界面培训,同时保持了原始准确性(表1).

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. • CIPR, a self-supervised objective that penalizes the KL divergence between an agent’s action distributions under two interfaces whose equivalent actions are known by construction, with a rescoring consistency KL that needs no additional generation and a rollout consistency KL that lets the agent’s reasoning differ between the interfaces (Section 3 ). • A tool-calling instantiation that canonicalizes tool names and pairs every training interface with a perturbed copy in which only descriptions and schemas identify the right tool (Sections 3.1 and 3.2 ). • Experiments in reinforcement-learning and supervised post-training, in which CIPR improves on standard post-training and multi-interface training under held-out interface perturbations and makes an agent fine-tuned on trajectories robust to renamed actions (Section 4 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Tool-use benchmarks mostly evaluate agents on the interface released with them ( Patil et al., 2025 ; Barres et al., 2026 ) , yet which tool an agent calls depends on how the tools are presented.
Renaming or corrupting tool and argument names, rephrasing queries, and adding related tools all lower accuracy ( Ye et al., 2024 ; Rabinovich and Tavor, 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ) , the wording and order of equivalent tools change which one is selected ( Faghih et al., 2025 ; Blankenstein et al., 2026 ) , and agents call a tool whose parameters fit the query even when the tool does not serve it ( Liu et al., 2026b ) .
Similar sensitivity to semantics-preserving rewrites appears in mathematical reasoning ( Mirzadeh et al., 2025 ) and in choices among reordered options ( Egressy and Stühmer, 2026 ) .
Training can deepen this reliance: PIPE, which rewrites environment interfaces while preserving task semantics, finds that fine-tuning on trajectories increases reliance on the training interface ( Gu et al., 2026 ) , and agent-tuning data entangles format following with reasoning ( Chen et al., 2024 ) .
These studies measure the problem, whereas we address it during training.
blocks.zh:
工具使用基准主要评价与其发布的界面上的代理(Patil等,2025;Barres等,2026),然而,代理使用哪种工具取决于工具的展示方式。
重新命名或腐蚀工具和参数名称,重写查询,并添加相关工具,所有更低的准确度(Ye等,2024;Rabinovich和Tavor,2025;Zhou等,2026b),等同工具的措辞和顺序有所改变,人们被选中(Faghih等,2025;Blankenstein等,2026),代理商称一个工具,即使该工具不提供服务,其参数也适合查询(Liu等,2026b).
与语义-保留重写类似的敏感性出现在数学推理(Mirzadeh等,2025年)和重排选项的选择(Egressy和Stühmer,2026年)中.
训练可以加深这种依赖:PIPE在保留任务语义的同时重写环境界面,发现对轨迹进行微调会增加对训练界面的依赖(Gu等,2026年),代理调取数据会跟随推理(Chen等,2024年).
这些研究衡量了这个问题,而我们在培训期间则处理了这个问题。

blocks.en:
Most remedies applied during training change what the agent sees.
They hide a cue, as function masking replaces names with random strings ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Qian et al., 2026 ) ; broaden the tools and environments seen in training, through synthesized APIs and agent data ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; Mekala et al., 2024 ) , generated environments ( Sullivan et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2026 ) , and tools that change over time ( Chen et al., 2025 ) ; or pair clean and perturbed versions of the same tasks ( Lv et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
Closest to our setting, ToolRL-DR randomizes the interface during tool-use reinforcement learning ( Zhou et al., 2026b ) , as multi-format supervision does for question formats ( Liu et al., 2026a ) .
Others change the target instead, scoring an action by its effect rather than its exact string ( Tang et al., 2026 ) .
Outside agents, shortcuts of this kind persist after the core features are learned ( Qiu et al., 2024 ) , and regularization or data rebalancing aimed at them can suppress causal features or lower worst-group accuracy ( Hong et al., 2025 ; LaBonte et al., 2024 ) .
In all of these, the objective still scores each training example on its own.
We keep the perturbed interfaces and add a term that compares the policy across them.
blocks.zh:
大多数在培训期间采用的补救办法都改变代理人所看到的。
它们隐藏了一个提示,因为函数遮掩用随机字符串来取代名称(Lin等,2025;Qian等,2026;通过综合API和代理数据来拓宽培训中看到的工具和环境(Liu等,2025;Zhang等,2025;He等,2025;Mekala等,2024)),生成环境. (Sullivan等,2025;Du等,2026),以及随时间变化的工具(Chen等,2025;或对等的清洁和扰动版本相同的任务(Lv等,2026;Chen等,2026.).
与我们的设置最相近,TolleRL-DR在工具使用加固学习过程中将界面随机化(周来等,2026b),如同多格式监管的问题格式(刘来等,2026a).
其他人则改变目标,按其效果而不是确切的弦来评分一项行动(Tang等人,2026年)。
外部物剂,此类捷径在了解了核心特征(邱等,2024年)后持续存在,针对这些特征的规范化或数据再平衡可以抑制因果特征或降低最差组的准确性(Hong等,2025年;LaBonte等,2024年).
在所有这些培训中,目标仍然单独对每个培训实例进行评分。
我们保留扰动的接口,并增加一个术语来比较它们之间的政策.

blocks.en:
Consistency regularization penalizes the divergence between a model’s predictions on two versions of an input that should receive the same prediction, such as an example and its augmentation in semi-supervised learning ( Xie et al., 2020 ) or semantically equivalent pairs in domain generalization ( Gao et al., 2024 ) .
It has been applied to reinforcement-learning policies on augmented observations ( Raileanu et al., 2021 ) and to vision-language-action policies under perturbed instructions and observations ( Luo et al., 2026 ) .
In concurrent work, PIRL applies it to reinforcement learning of multimodal LLMs with a per-token KL between the policy’s next-token distributions for the same response under a clean and an adversarially perturbed prompt ( Zhou et al., 2026a ) .
Each of these methods compares the two predictions directly, which assumes the correct output is the same under both inputs.
Renaming tools breaks this assumption, because the correct call is then written with different tokens, so we compare distributions over actions matched through the known correspondence between the two interfaces.
blocks.zh:
一致性规范化会惩罚模型对应当获得相同预测的两个版本的输入的预测之间的差异,例如一个实例及其在半监督学习中的增强(Xie等,2020年)或域通化中的等效对(Gao等,2024年).
它被应用于关于增强观测的强化学习政策(Raileanu等,2021年)和在扰动的指示和观察下的愿景语言行动政策(Luo等,2026年)。
在同时开展的工作中,PIRL将其应用于强化学习多式有限责任公司,在保险单的下一份分配中,在干净的和有对抗性的扰动的催化下,用每份KL(周等,2026年a)对同一反应进行分配。 。 。 。 。
这两种方法都直接比较两种预测,假设两种输入下正确的输出相同.
重新命名工具打破了这个假设,因为正确的调用随后会用不同的符号来写出,因此我们比较了通过已知的两个接口之间的对应动作的分布.

blocks.en: 3 Cross-Interface Policy Regularization
blocks.zh: 3 跨部门政策规范化

blocks.en:
We consider an LLM agent that receives a user query together with an interface, which lists the available tools with their names, descriptions, and argument schemas.
At each step the agent either calls one of the listed tools or responds without a call.
A perturbation of the interface is semantics-preserving when the tool that solves the task is still available and still solves it, even though its name, its position, or the surrounding options have changed.
We want the agent to assign the same probability to equivalent tools under such perturbations, and CIPR trains for this in three steps.
We canonicalize the interface so that tool names carry no task information (Section 3.1 ), pair every training example with a perturbed copy of its interface (Section 3.2 ), and penalize the divergence between the agent’s action distributions under the two interfaces (Section 3.3 ).
Figure 2 summarizes the procedure.
blocks.zh:
我们认为是一个LLM代理,它接收用户查询,并有一个接口,其中列出了可用的工具及其名称、描述和论证计划。
每一步,代理人要么拨打所列工具之一,要么不拨打就回复。
界面的扰动是语义保留,当解决任务的工具仍然可用并仍然解决时,即使它的名称,位置,或周围的选项已经改变.
我们希望代理商在这种扰动下给同等工具分配同样的概率,CIPR为此分三步进行列车.
我们把界面化,使工具名称不包含任务信息(第3.1节),将每个培训实例同其界面的扰动拷贝相配(第3.2节),并惩罚代理人在两个界面下的行动分布之间的分歧(第3.3节)。
图2概述了程序。

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : Overview of CIPR. We first canonicalize the interface, renaming the two tools of a weather query f 01 f_{01} and f 02 f_{02} , short for function_01 and function_02 .
We then build a perturbed interface that adds a degraded twin of every tool, such as the deprecated forecast f 73 f_{73} , and assigns all tools new identifiers in a new order.

blocks.en: 3.1 Canonicalization
blocks.zh: 3.1 加农化

blocks.en:
The most direct shortcut available to a trained agent is a familiar tool name.
Because a name that led to correct calls during training usually still does so at test time, a policy can select tools by name without reading their descriptions, and function-calling models are known to be misled by naming conventions ( Lin et al., 2025 ) .
We remove this shortcut by canonicalizing the interface, replacing every tool name with a neutral identifier and every argument name with an identifier numbered within its tool, so that forecast(city, date) becomes function_01(arg_01, arg_02) .
We keep descriptions, types, required arguments, and argument values unchanged, so the agent has to read the descriptions to tell the tools apart, and we apply the same mapping to every reference to these names in the query, in earlier turns, and in the training targets.
At inference, a canonicalization adapter applies this mapping to the incoming interface and translates the generated call back to the executable API, so the deployed tools themselves are never modified.
Canonicalization is related to function masking ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , a training strategy that replaces names with random strings so that the model attends to descriptions; unlike masking, we also apply the mapping at inference, so the policy never meets the original names.

训练有素的代理最直接的捷径是熟悉的工具名.

我们删除这个快捷键的方法是将接口条形化,用中性标识符来取代每个工具名,用工具内编号的标识符来取代每个参数名,这样预测(城市,日期)就成为函数_01(arg_01,arg_02).

blocks.en:
The consistency KL of Section 3.3 needs only a perturbed interface in which we know which tool is equivalent to which canonical tool.
We design ours to also remove the cues that canonicalization leaves in place, such as a tool’s position in the tool list or the identifiers seen during training, and construct it for every training example from the canonical interface in three steps.
We first give every tool a degraded twin ( twin expansion ), a copy whose description states that it is worse, for example deprecated or slower, or whose schema replaces an argument the task needs with an unrelated one.
We then give the expanded tool list new identifiers ( relabeling ) and shuffle the tools and their arguments ( reordering ).
The query and the descriptions of the original tools are unchanged, and each twin differs from its original only in its description or schema.
Appendix B lists the exact operations.

blocks.en:
The task objective never compares which tools the policy chooses under the canonical and the perturbed interface.
We add this comparison by building on consistency regularization ( Xie et al., 2020 ; Raileanu et al., 2021 ) , which penalizes the divergence between a model’s predictions on two versions of an input that call for the same output.
An agent’s correct response, however, changes with the interface, because the tools it calls have different names, and what stays fixed is the correspondence between equivalent tools, which is known from the construction of the perturbed interface.
We therefore compare the policy’s distributions over actions rather than over tokens.

blocks.en:
We evaluate CIPR in reinforcement-learning and supervised post-training of agents.
If the consistency KL removes interface shortcuts rather than fitting the training perturbations, CIPR should raise accuracy under held-out perturbations, keep or raise accuracy on the original interface, and improve on multi-interface training, which sees the same perturbed interfaces without the consistency KL.
We test these three predictions by adding CIPR to reinforcement learning for function calling (Section 4.2 ); we then apply it to supervised post-training on WebShop (Section 4.3 ) and ablate its components (Section 4.4 ).

如果一致性KL去除接口快捷键而不是装配训练扰动,CIPR应当在被阻断扰动下提高精度,保持或提高原始接口的精度,并改进多界面训练,多界面训练可以看到没有一致性KL的同一扰动接口.
我们试验这三项预测,即在功能调用强化学习中加入CIPR(第4.2节);然后将其应用于WebShop(第4.3节)的监督下的后期培训,并放弃其组件(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: We build all reinforcement-learning experiments on the public ToolRL recipe ( Qian et al., 2026 ) , so the compared models differ only in their training interfaces and objective.
blocks.zh: 我们在公共工具RL食谱(Qian等,2026年)上建立了所有强化学习实验,因此比较模型仅在培训接口和目标上有所不同.

blocks.en:
We train with GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) on the 3,920 3{,}920 ToolRL training examples, rewarding correct calls and format.
We use two backbones, Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct ( Qwen Team, 2024 ) with tools in the prompt and Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) with thinking and native function calling.
Appendix A lists hyperparameters.
blocks.zh:
我们用GRPO(Shao等人,2024年)来训练3,920 3{,}920 ToolRL训练范例,奖励正确的呼叫和格式.
我们使用两个骨干,Quen2.5-3B-Instruct(Quen Team,2024年),工具在即时和Quen3.5-4B(Quen Team,2026年),具有思维和本土功能召唤.
附 录 一个列出超参数。

blocks.en:
We compare four models on each backbone. Base is the backbone without post-training, and ToolRL (GRPO) , our standard post-training baseline, is the backbone post-trained with the ToolRL recipe; both are evaluated with the original tool names, as they would be deployed.
Multi-interface training adds the perturbed interfaces of Section 3.2 to ToolRL training, as in ToolRL-DR ( Zhou et al., 2026b ) , and CIPR adds both consistency terms to it; the tables label these models + multi-interface and + CIPR.
We train both with canonical names on the same interfaces and evaluate both through the canonicalization adapter, so that they differ only in whether the policy is compared across them.
blocks.zh:
我们比较每个骨干上的4个模型 基地是没有后培训的骨干,我们的标准后培训基线TolRL(GRPO)是使用TolRL配方进行后培训的骨干;两者都按照原始工具名进行评估,因为将部署它们。
多界面培训将第3.2节的扰动界面添加到TolRL培训中,如TolRL-DR(周克等,2026b),CIPR在其中增加了两条一致性术语;表格将这些模型标注为+多界面和+CIPR.
我们在同一个界面上用卡通名称来训练,并通过卡通化适配器来评价两者,这样它们只在政策是否相互比较上有所不同.

blocks.en:
We evaluate on the 2,501 2{,}501 single-turn items of BFCL v4 ( Patil et al., 2025 ) that have a reference call, under thirteen perturbation types adapted from RobustBench-TC ( Zhou et al., 2026b ) (Appendix C ).
None of them is used during training, and we report them in three groups. Typos & distractor tools introduces typos into the query or adds a distractor for every tool the task calls, either an unrelated tool renamed to resemble it or a duplicate with the same name whose description or parameters are corrupted.
The six cost and latency types add a cheaper or faster equivalent of the correct tool under a new name, so that the familiar name now points to the worse choice.
As in RobustBench-TC, the query in Cost & latency (explicit) asks for the better tool, for example “Please use a cost-effective option”. This request tells the agent what to prefer, so we add a harder version, Cost & latency (implicit) , in which the query only asks the agent to describe the available tools and states no preference.
These two groups are the hardest test, because the right choice depends only on a stated cost or latency, and preferring a cheaper or faster tool is never rewarded during training.
Beyond single-turn calls, we evaluate the three groups on the airline and retail domains of τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench ( Barres et al., 2026 ) , where the agent completes multi-turn tasks with a simulated user, and Appendix F also reports RoTBench ( Ye et al., 2024 ) , which corrupts tool and parameter names at graded levels.
blocks.zh:
我们评价BFCL v4(Patil等,2025年)的2 501 2{,}501个单回转项目,这些单回转项目具有参考性,属于由Robust Bench-TC(周等,2026b)(附录C.)改编而成的13个扰动类型。
培训期间没有使用过,我们分三组报告。 Typos & 分散工具向查询中引入了打字器,或者为任务所调用的每一个工具添加了分取器,要么是一个被重新命名为类似它的不相干的工具,要么是一个描述或参数被损坏的同名重复.
六种成本和耐用类型在新名下增加了更便宜或更快的等效正确工具,这样熟悉的名称现在指向更糟糕的选择.
与Robust Bench-TC一样,Cost & latency(明确)中的查询要求有更好的工具,例如“请使用成本效益高的选择”。 这个请求告诉代理商喜欢什么,所以我们添加了更硬的版本"Cost & latency (隐性地)",其中查询只要求代理商描述可用的工具,并声明没有偏好.
这两个团体是最难的考验,因为正确的选择只取决于申报的成本或耐久性,而更喜欢更便宜或更快的工具在训练期间永远得不到奖励.
除了单回合通话之外,我们评价航空公司和零售领域的三个小组,即:\ 2\tau^{2}-bench(Barres等人,2026年),其中代理商以模拟用户完成多回合任务,附录F还报告RoTBench(Ye等人,2024年),这在分级级别上腐蚀了工具和参数名.

blocks.en: 4.2 Robustness to held-out perturbations
blocks.zh: 4.2 强力制止被搁置的扰动

blocks.en: Table 1 tests the three predictions on BFCL.
blocks.zh: 表1测试了BFCL上的三项预测.

blocks.en:
Table 1 : Full-call accuracy (%) on BFCL under interface perturbations. Tool names gives the names each model sees at evaluation.
Each model is evaluated with the names it was trained on, as it would be deployed, so Base and ToolRL (GRPO) see the original names, and the multi-interface and CIPR models, which are trained with canonical names, see canonical names through the canonicalization adapter.
Gray rows evaluate Base and ToolRL (GRPO) through the canonicalization adapter as well. In distribution applies the perturbation used in training (Section 3.2 ), which is defined on canonical names, so rows with the original names show n/a. Mean averages the three held-out groups, and Gap is original accuracy minus the mean.
Bold marks the best value per backbone, excluding gray rows.
All 95 % 95\% confidence intervals have half-widths of at most 2.0 2.0 points, and Appendix D reports each perturbation type.
blocks.zh:
表1:接口扰动下BFCL的全调精确度(%). 工具名称给出了每个模型在评价中看到的名称.
每个模型都用它所训练的名称来评价,因为将部署这些名称,因此Base和ToolRL(GRPO)可以看到原名,多界面和CIPR模型通过Cononicalization适配器来查看被训练的克南克名.
灰行通过Cononicalization适配器来评价 Base和TolRL(GRPO). 在分发中,应用了训练中使用的扰动(第3.2节),它被定义于犬名上,所以与原名相排显示n/a. 平均值为三个被搁置组别,而Gap为原精度减去平均值.
粗体标出每个骨干的最大价值,不包括灰色行.
95%-95%-%的置信间隔最多有2.0-2.0分之半,附录D报告每个扰动类型.

blocks.en:
Standard post-training leaves most of the gap in place.
On Qwen2.5-3B, ToolRL (GRPO) raises original accuracy by 9.6 9.6 points, yet its gap grows from 29.8 29.8 to 32.7 32.7 points, because the familiar name it learned to follow now points to the worse tool.
On Qwen3.5-4B, whose base model is already trained for tool use, the gap narrows only from 10.2 10.2 to 8.4 8.4 points.
blocks.zh:
标准后训练留下了大部分空白.
在"Quen2.5-3B"上,TolorRL(GRPO)将原生精度提高了9.6 9.6分,然而其差距从29.8 29.8分增加到32.7 32.7分,因为它所学的熟悉的名字现在指向了更糟糕的工具.
在已接受工具使用训练的Quen3.5-4B上,差距从10.2 10.2缩小到8.4 8.4分.

blocks.en:
Canonical names are not a free improvement for a model trained without them (gray rows).
They lower the original accuracy of both base models and of ToolRL (GRPO), and although they raise the cost and latency accuracy of ToolRL (GRPO) on Qwen2.5-3B, they lower its accuracy in every held-out group on Qwen3.5-4B.
blocks.zh:
冠名对于没有被训练的模特来说并不是自由的改进(gray rains).
它们降低了基础模型和ToolRL(GRPO)的原始精度,虽然它们提高了Quen2.5-3B上ToolRL(GRPO)的成本和耐久性精度,但是它们降低了Quen3.5-4B上每个被搁置组的精度.

blocks.en:
Training on perturbed interfaces makes canonical names pay off, and the consistency KL adds to that gain.
On both backbones, CIPR is higher than multi-interface training on the original interface and in every held-out group.
The largest gains are on the cost and latency perturbations, the ones least like anything seen in training, with 2.1 2.1 and 2.7 2.7 points on Qwen2.5-3B and 2.3 2.3 points on the implicit version for Qwen3.5-4B, while the other differences are within the 95 % 95\% confidence intervals.
Under the perturbation used in training ( In distribution ), the two models differ by about a point or less on both backbones, so the advantage of CIPR lies in the perturbations that training did not cover.
On both backbones, CIPR thus matches or exceeds the original accuracy of ToolRL (GRPO) while raising its mean accuracy under perturbation by 15.5 15.5 and 4.3 4.3 points.
blocks.zh:
关于扰动接口的培训使犬名得到回报,而一致性KL增加了这一收益.
在两个骨干上,CIPR都高于关于原始接口和每个被搁置组的多界面培训.
最大的收益在于成本和耐用性扰动,最不像在训练中看到的任何东西,Quen2.5-3B的2.1分和2.7 2.7分,而Wen3.5-4B的隐含版本的2.3 2.3分,而其他差异则在95%95-%的置信间隔内.
在训练中使用的扰动(在分布上)下,两种模式在两种骨干上大约各有一点或更少的不同,因此CIPR的优点在于训练没有覆盖的扰动.
在两个主干上,CIPR因此匹配或超过TOL(GRPO)的原始精度,同时在扰动下将其平均精度提高了15.5 15.5分和4.3 4.3分.

blocks.en: On τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench, the Qwen3.5-4B CIPR model has the smallest gap in both domains between its original reward and its mean reward under the three groups, although ToolRL (GRPO) with the original names has a higher reward on the original interface and under every group (Table 8 ).
blocks.zh: 在\tau\2} - Bench, Quen3.5 - 4B 上 CIPR模式在这两个领域,其原始奖励与三个组下的平均奖励之间的差距都最小,尽管原名的TolRL(GRPO)在原始界面和每个组下都有较高的奖励(表8.

blocks.en: 4.3 Supervised post-training
blocks.zh: 4.3 监督培训后

blocks.en: We next apply CIPR to an agent trained by supervised learning, AgentLM-7B ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) , whose WebShop policy collapses when its actions are renamed ( Gu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们接下来将CIPR应用到接受监督学习培训的特工,AgentLM-7B(Zeng等,2024年),其WebShop政策被重新命名后崩溃了(Gu等,2026年).

blocks.en:
AgentLM is fine-tuned on agent trajectories mixed with general instruction data, and acts on WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) through two actions named search and click .
The released model already solves the task under its original action names, so we apply CIPR as self-distillation.
The released model is the teacher and initializes the student, which we train to match it under canonical names and, through the rescoring consistency KL, under relabeled names, without additional rollouts.
blocks.zh:
AgentLM在代理轨迹上被微调与通用指令数据相混合,通过两个名为搜索和点击的动作在WebShop(姚等,2022年)上行为.
所发布的模型已经用它最初的动作名解决了任务,因此我们应用了CIPR作为自沉.
所发行的模型是老师并初始化学生,我们通过Cononical names来训练以匹配学生,并通过重分一致性 KL,再加标签后的名字,而无需再推出.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : WebShop evaluation on AgentLM-7B before (blue) and after (green) CIPR self-distillation, under different names.
blocks.zh: 图3:在(蓝色)和(绿色)CIPR自我消化之前对AgentLM-7B的WebShop评价,名称不同.

blocks.en:
Table 2 : Ablations on Qwen2.5-3B (accuracy, %, canonical names).
Each row removes one component from CIPR, and removing the consistency KL gives multi-interface training; † one added near-duplicate tool takes the place of the twins.
The gray row is ToolRL (GRPO) with canonical names.

Consistent with Gu et al. (2026) , renaming search and click to the synonyms find and press reduces the released model’s reward from 78.9 78.9 to 5.5 5.5 (Figure 3 ).
After self-distillation, the agent reaches 81.0 81.0 under canonical names, the interface it is deployed with, against 75.7 75.7 for the released model behind the same adapter, so the adapter alone does not explain the gain.
Seeing the names directly, the trained agent is also robust to neutral renaming, with 76.0 76.0 under the synonyms.
Swapped names, each of which suggests the other action, drive both models to zero, which is why CIPR keeps the canonicalization adapter, behind which a misleading name never reaches the policy.
blocks.zh:
与Gu等人(2026年)一致,重命名搜索并点击同义词查找并按下,将所发布的模型的奖励从78.9 78.9降至5.5 (图3.
在自沉后,该剂在克能克名下达到81.0 81.0,与之相接的接口,而同一适配器后方的放出型号则为75.7 75.7,因此仅适配器并不能解释收益.
直接看到名字后,训练有素的代理人也坚固到中性更名,同义词下为76.0 76.0.
抽取名称,每个名称都暗示了其他动作,将两个模型推向了零,这就是为什么CIPR保留了"能动化适配器",在后方一个误导名从未到达政策.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.4 拖欠款项

blocks.en:
Table 2 ablates the consistency KL, the twins, and the reordering of the perturbed interface on Qwen2.5-3B, with every model evaluated under canonical names (Table 9 lists every run).
It reports accuracy on the original interface and on the explicit cost and latency perturbations, where only the stated cost or latency identifies the right tool.
blocks.zh:
表2降低了一致性KL,双胞胎,并重排了Quen2.5-3B上被扰动的界面,每个模型都根据犬名进行评估(表9列出每跑一次).
它报告原始接口的准确性,并报告明确的费用和延迟扰动,只有申报的费用或延迟才能确定正确的工具。

blocks.en: Without the consistency KL, the method reduces to multi-interface training on the same interfaces, and accuracy falls from 53.6 % 53.6\% to 51.7 % 51.7\% on the explicit cost and latency perturbations and from 74.9 % 74.9\% to 73.5 % 73.5\% on the original interface, consistent with the difference between the two methods in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 如果没有一致性KL,该方法会减少为同一接口的多界面培训,准确度从53.6% 53.6\%降至51.7% 51.7\%,明确成本和耐用扰动率从74.9% 74.9\%降至73.5% 73.5\%,与表1中两种方法的相差相符合.

blocks.en:
The twins contribute the most.
Without them, accuracy on the explicit cost and latency perturbations falls from 53.6 % 53.6\% to 48.1 % 48.1\% , and with a single added near-duplicate tool in place of twins and reordering it falls to 43.7 % 43.7\% , below ToolRL (GRPO) with canonical names.
Trained with a single added tool, the model relies on position rather than on the stated costs, with 70.8 % 70.8\% when the correct tool comes first and 16.5 % 16.5\% when the costlier equivalent does (Table 9 ).
The consistency KL also gains more from twins, adding 1.9 1.9 points with them against 0.6 0.6 with reordering alone (Table 9 ).
blocks.zh:
双胞胎的贡献最大。
没有它们,明确成本和耐久性扰动的准确度从53.6% 53.6 %下降到48.1% 48.1 % 。 单加的近似重复工具取代了双胞胎,并重排到43.7% 43.7 % , 低于带有冠名的TolRL(GRPO)。
该模式使用一个单一的附加工具,依靠的是位置而不是说明的成本,在正确工具第一时为70.8%,在费用较高的等值时为16.5%(表9)。
双胞胎还增加了1.9分和0.6分,单是重新排序(表9)。

blocks.en:
Canonical names are needed at inference as well.
Evaluated with the original names, the CIPR model reaches 28.7 % 28.7\% on the explicit cost and latency perturbations in the original tool order, against 60.5 % 60.5\% with canonical names, because the familiar name belongs to the costlier tool (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh:
推断也需要冠名。
根据原名的评价,CIR模型在原始工具顺序中明确成本和耐用性扰动度达到了28.7%-%,而60.5%-60.5%-%为冠名,因为熟悉的名称属于更昂贵的工具(附录D.).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
LLM agents learn to use tools through a particular interface, and the task objective cannot tell a decision that depends on the task from one that depends on how the tools are presented.
We supply that distinction with CIPR, a self-supervised consistency KL between the agent’s action distributions under two interfaces whose equivalent actions are known by construction.
Added to multi-interface training, it improves accuracy in all three groups of held-out BFCL perturbations on both backbones without lowering accuracy on the original interface (Table 1 ).
Applied as self-distillation, it makes AgentLM robust to renaming its WebShop actions.
Because the targets come from the policy itself, the objective needs no annotation beyond the task, which makes it a natural candidate for agentic training at scale.
blocks.zh:
LLM代理学习通过特定接口使用工具,任务目标不能从一个取决于工具的呈现方式的决定中告诉一个取决于任务的决定.
我们提供这种与CIR的区别,这是代理商在两个接口下的行动分布之间自我监督的一致KL,而这两个接口的等同行动是通过构造而知道的。
添加到多界面培训中,它提高了两根主干线上所有三组被搁置的BFCL扰动的精度,而不会降低原始接口的精度(表1.).
作为自我消化应用,它使AgentLM强大地重新命名了它的WebShop动作.
由于目标来自政策本身,因此目标不需要超出任务的说明,这使得它成为规模的代理训练的自然人选.

blocks.en:
CIPR needs the canonicalization adapter at inference, because a name that misrepresents its action, such as the swapped WebShop names in Figure 3 , still misleads a trained agent that sees it directly.
The consistency KL constrains which tool the agent calls and whether it calls one, while arguments are learned from the task loss alone, and argument errors barely change in our error analysis (Appendix E ).
It also requires a perturbation whose equivalences are known, which is direct for tool lists but harder to construct for richer actions such as edits to a program.
The rollout consistency KL samples an additional group of rollouts per prompt, which raises the cost of training.
Our experiments use models of up to 9 9 B parameters, one training run per configuration, and mostly single-turn function calling, so the effect at larger scale and in long multi-turn tasks remains to be established.
blocks.zh:
CIPR在推断时需要Cononicalization适配器,因为如图3中被互换的WebShop名等不实其动作的名称仍然误导了直接看到它的训练有素的代理.
一致性 KL 限制了代理调用的工具以及它是否调用一个工具,而参数仅从任务损失中学习,而参数错误在我们的错误分析中几乎没有改变(附录 E ) 。
它还需要一种已知等同性的扰动,这种扰动对工具列表来说是直接的,但对于更丰富的动作,如编辑到一个程序来说则更难构建.
推出一致性 " KL " 样本显示,每批快速推出一组,提高了培训费用。
我们的实验使用最多9个9 B参数的模型,每个配置一个训练运行,并且大多是单回合函数调用,所以在更大的规模和长多回合任务中的效果仍有待确定.

blocks.en: Appendix A Training details
blocks.zh: 附录A 培训详情

blocks.en: This appendix gives the hyperparameters of the reinforcement-learning runs (Table 3 ) and the full CIPR training procedure (Algorithm 1 ).
blocks.zh: 本附录提供了强化学习运行的超参数(表3)和完整的CIPR培训程序(算法1)。

blocks.en:
All reinforcement-learning runs build on ToolRL ( Qian et al., 2026 ) and keep its optimizer settings.
The task objective is GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) with rewards for call correctness and response format and no reference-policy KL; calling a degraded twin earns the same reward as any other wrong call.

所有加固学习都以TolRL(Qian等,2026年)为基础并保持其优化设置.
任务目标是GRPO(Shao等,2024年),因调用正确性和响应格式而获得奖励,没有参考政策KL;调用退化的双胞胎获得的奖励与任何其他错误的调用相同.

blocks.en:
Table 5 lists the thirteen held-out perturbation types, adapted from RobustBench-TC ( Zhou et al., 2026b ) , and the group of Table 1 in which we report each.
The six cost and latency types share one construction.
The tool list contains the correct tool and an equivalent with the same description but a higher stated cost or latency; the equivalent keeps the original tool’s name and the correct tool receives a new one, so that the familiar name points to the costlier or slower tool.
The cost or latency is stated as a tag, in natural language, or as a tag together with an abbreviated name for the correct tool.
Each type is evaluated in two versions.
In the explicit version, as in RobustBench-TC, the query asks for the cheaper or faster tool; in the implicit version, which we add, the query asks the agent to describe the available tools and their properties before acting and states no preference.
With canonical names, we canonicalize after constructing each interface, and because canonical identifiers follow the tool order, we average two orders, the original one and one in which the costlier or slower equivalent comes first; with original names, we use the original order. Figure 4 shows one item under each construction.

This is the decision the consistency KL constrains, since it compares distributions over tools and the no-call outcome and does not inspect arguments.

blocks.en:
Argument failures barely change, and their share rises because more items reach the argument check.
Given that the correct tool was called, the rate of argument failure is 12.07 % 12.07\% for ToolRL (GRPO) and 11.61 % 11.61\% for CIPR.

blocks.en:
Two small classes move against CIPR.
The CIPR model declines to call any tool on 388 388 more perturbed items and emits the wrong number of calls on 120 120 more.
The query in the implicit version asks for a description of the tools before acting, and the CIPR model is more likely to give the description and stop.
Because the action distribution includes a no-call entry, an objective that equalizes distributions across interfaces can be partly satisfied by moving probability onto not calling, and we regard this as a cost of the current instantiation.

blocks.en:
We use the First-Turn split and all five shipped levels, a clean tool list and the slight , medium , heavy , and union corruptions derived from it.
Following the definitions of Ye et al. (2024) , the slight level inserts, omits, or substitutes characters in the names of half of the tools or half of the parameters, and the medium level reverses such names or replaces them with random strings.
The heavy level either shuffles all tool names among the tools, which detaches each name from its description, or, in half of the tools, adds a mandatory parameter with a random name and shuffles the parameter names, each with probability one half.
The union level combines one noise on tool names with one on parameter names, drawn from the other levels.
The corruptions ship as data, so every model sees an identical tool list at a given level.
Scoring is the benchmark’s deterministic Content-Filling criterion, which requires the predicted call to match an accepted reference on tool name, argument keys, and argument values.
We apply the benchmark’s matcher unmodified and recompute it per item so that original and canonical names can be compared item by item.
blocks.zh:
我们使用"第一回合"(First-Turn)和所有5个发货级别,一个干净的工具清单以及由此产生的轻微,中,重,和工会腐败.
按照Ye等人(2024年)的定义,在半个工具或半个参数的名称中轻轻地插入,省略,或取而代之的字符,而中层则倒置此类名称或以随机字符串取而代之.
重等要么在工具中洗去所有工具名,将每个名称从描述中解去,要么在一半工具中添加一个带有随机名称的强制参数并洗去参数名,每个参数名的概率为一分之一.
联盟级将工具名上的一个噪声和参数名上的一个噪声结合起来,从其他级别中抽取.
腐败将船装为数据,因此每个模型都看到一个特定级别上相同的工具列表.
Scoring 是基准的确定性Content-Filling标准,它要求预测的调用匹配工具名,参数键,和参数值上公认的引用.
我们使用基准的匹配器进行未修改,并按项目重新计算,以便可以逐项比较原始名称和名称。

blocks.en:
For canonical names, we replace every tool name with a canonical identifier assigned by position and leave descriptions, argument values, and the query unchanged.
Because RoTBench’s corruptions act mainly on names, canonicalizing a shipped corruption file would give a corrupted name the same canonical identifier as its clean version and undo most of the corruption.
We therefore canonicalize the clean record first and re-apply each level’s corruption to the canonical identifier.
This preserves the structure of each level, introduces no duplicated identifier with either original or canonical names, and keeps the queries and their order identical, so the pairing is exact.
blocks.zh:
对于cononical name,我们用一个由位置和保留描述,参数值,以及查询不变的cononic 标识来替换每一个工具名.
ROTBench的腐败行为主要以姓名为主, 将一个被运去的腐败文件化,
因此,我们首先把干净的记录说清楚,然后把各级的腐败重新应用到犬科的标识上。
这保留了每个关卡的结构,没有引入带有原名或冠名的重复标识符,并且使查询及其顺序完全相同,因此对接准确.

blocks.en:
Table 10 reports accuracy with original and with canonical names.
Under original names, every model loses the most accuracy on the heavy and union levels.
Canonicalization costs accuracy on the clean and lightly corrupted tool lists and recovers it on the heavy and union levels.
On the heavy level, half of the items shuffle the tool names, so under original names each name labels the description of a different tool, which can mislead a model that selects tools by name; under canonical names the shuffled labels carry no meaning, and the choice falls back on the descriptions.
Under canonical names, the spread between the clean tool list and the corrupted levels narrows for every model, in several cases by more than half.
blocks.zh:
表10报告的准确性为原文并带有犬名。
在原名下,每个型号在重和联盟级别上都失去了最准确的.
Canonicalization在干净和被轻度腐蚀的工具列表中花费了精度,并在重度和工会级别上回收.
在重的关卡上,有一半的物品会洗去工具名,所以在原名下,每个名下都会给不同工具的描述贴上标签,这可以误导一个按名称选择工具的模型;在被洗去的名下,被洗去的标签没有意义,选择回落到描述上.
在犬名下,清洁工具列表和被腐烂的级别之间的分布对每个模型都收窄了,有几起案例比一半以上.

blocks.en:
The two backbones are evaluated with the tool-call format each was trained for, so entries can be compared within a backbone but not across backbones.
On Qwen2.5-3B, canonical names help on the corrupted levels, and with them CIPR and multi-interface training share the best pooled accuracy.
The largest effect in the table is scale, since the largest CIPR model is both the most accurate and the flattest across corruption levels, with a drop of only 0.3 0.3 points from the clean tool list once names are canonical.
blocks.zh:
对两个骨干进行了评价,每个骨干都接受了工具调用格式的培训,因此可以在骨干内部而不是在骨干之间进行比较。
在Qwen2.5-3B上,犬名帮助了被腐烂的级别,与他们一起CIPR和多界面训练共享最好的集合精度.
表中最大的影响是规模,因为最大的CIPR模型既是最准确的,也是腐败程度最平平的,一旦名字被冠名,则从干净的工具清单中只下降0.3分.
